name: cli-anything-bridge
description: Bridge CLI-Anything generated CLIs into the Claw tool layer.

tools.name: cli_anything_status
tools.description: Inspect whether a CLI-Anything runtime or generated executable is available on this machine.

command.description: Optional explicit executable name or path to inspect.

tools.name: cli_anything_run
tools.description: Run a CLI-Anything generated CLI or compatible command through the Claw tool layer.

command.description: Optional explicit executable name or absolute path. If omitted, the bridge tries CLI_ANYTHING_COMMAND and then common candidate names.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the target CLI.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the target CLI.

env.description: Optional extra environment variables for the child process.
